command_line:
set -eu
Rscript - "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/80293908/inputs/dataset_8ba6e8d3-df90-4138-851f-eac856bc75ef.dat" "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/80293908/inputs/dataset_ba6b593c-decd-4a19-9810-8282f7ecd6a6.dat" <<'RS'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
counts_path <- args[1]
layout_path <- args[2]
counts <- read.csv(counts_path, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
layout <- read.csv(layout_path, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
layout$matrix_id <- gsub("-", "_", layout$SampleID, fixed=TRUE)
keep <- layout$Group %in% c("DMSO", "CBD_IC50")
design_df <- layout[keep, c("matrix_id", "Group"), drop=FALSE]
if (nrow(design_df) != 6L) stop("Expected exactly six samples for DMSO and CBD_IC50")
if (anyDuplicated(rownames(counts))) stop("Duplicate gene identifiers")
if (!all(design_df$matrix_id %in% colnames(counts))) stop("Metadata sample IDs do not match count matrix columns")
count_mat <- as.matrix(counts[, design_df$matrix_id, drop=FALSE])
storage.mode(count_mat) <- "integer"
coldata <- data.frame(condition=factor(design_df$Group, levels=c("DMSO","CBD_IC50")), row.names=design_df$matrix_id)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=count_mat, colData=coldata, design=~condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c("condition","CBD_IC50","DMSO"), alpha=0.05)
out <- data.frame(gene_id=rownames(res), as.data.frame(res), check.names=FALSE)
out <- out[order(out$padj, na.last=TRUE), , drop=FALSE]
write.table(out, "deseq2_all.tsv", sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na="NA")
eligible <- !is.na(res$padj)
up <- eligible & res$padj < 0.05 & res$log2FoldChange > 0.5
down <- eligible & res$padj < 0.05 & res$log2FoldChange < -0.5
writeLines(rownames(res)[up], "up_genes.txt")
writeLines(rownames(res)[down], "down_genes.txt")
writeLines(rownames(res)[eligible], "universe_genes.txt")
summary <- data.frame(method="DESeq2", version=as.character(packageVersion("DESeq2")), contrast="CBD_IC50_vs_DMSO", alpha=0.05, padj_threshold=0.05, abs_log2fc_threshold=0.5, n_samples=ncol(count_mat), n_eligible=sum(eligible), n_up=sum(up), n_down=sum(down))
write.table(summary, "summary.tsv", sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
RS
